My forest generator created cycles or paths > 32. Let me fix: parent = 'q%d' % (i - 1 - (i % d)) — for i=1, d=min(1,32)=1 → parent = q(1-1-0)= q0 ✓; for i=2, d=2 → parent = q(2-1-0)=q1 ✓; i=3, d=3 → parent = q(3-1-0) = q2; i=4,d=4 → q3... this creates a chain of unbounded depth. Let me instead use: parent index = max(0, i - 1 - rnd.randrange(min(i, 5))) and enforce depth ≤ 32 by computing depths.

Simpler: build nodes with an explicit depth list: for i>0, parent = a random node among those with depth < 32 (track depth). Let me rewrite.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('tests/plan_perf.py'); s=p.read_text()
old = s[s.index('    def forest(n, depth):'):s.index('    rq = forest')]
new = '''    def forest(n, depth):
        nodes = []
        depths = []
        for i in range(n):
            if i == 0:
                parent = None; d = 1
            else:
                candidates = [j for j in range(i) if depths[j] < depth]
                j = candidates[rnd.randrange(len(candidates))]
                parent = 'q%d' % j; d = depths[j] + 1
            depths.append(d)
            nodes.append({'id': 'q%d' % i, 'parent': parent, 'capacity': rnd.choice([0, 1, 2, 5, 4096])})
        return nodes
'''
s = s.replace(old, new)
p.write_text(s)
EOF
cd /workspace && timeout 2400 python3 tests/plan_perf.py
